entities.name: Södra Råda Old Church
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: Södra Råda Old Church was an early 14th-century timbered church in the parish of Södra Råda in Gullspång Municipality, Västra Götaland in Sweden. It was one of the oldest preserved wooden churches in the country.
